reasons: The restricted-v2 SCC rejected the operations adapter's fixed fsGroup 65532.
The namespace-scoped Argo CD seat role did not include KubeVirt VirtualMachine resources.
The generated Route hostname's first DNS label exceeded 63 characters.
remediation: Let OpenShift allocate the namespace-specific supplemental group.
Extend the existing per-seat Argo CD role with namespaced KubeVirt resources.
Generate a compact deterministic route label using the target ingress domain.
